towns.name: Town of Felton

reporting.basis: Actual results (as reported to the Census Bureau's Annual Survey of Local Government Finances)
reporting.scope: All municipal funds, including utilities; schools are run by separate school districts

ledger.description: Interest, rents, sale of property, special assessments and other
Utility, transit and ABC store charges

sources.label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, individual unit file

notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024, as the municipality reported them to the Census Bureau's Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances. Not a budget.
Public schools are run by separate school districts, and Kent County provides many other services; residents pay the town, the county and the school district.
Covers every fund, including water, sewer, electric and other utilities. Debt service counts interest and principal repaid; borrowing and transfers between funds are left out.
Courts, legal services, public buildings, housing and community development count as overhead.
Debt is long-term debt outstanding plus short-term debt at year end.

Political money is not scored: no candidates for town council or commission and mayor reported contributions to the Department of Elections since 2023 (municipal candidates who raise and spend $5,000 or less do not file reports).
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.
